en: Therīgāthā 2.4 Dukanipāta: The Verses of the Elder Nun Aḍḍhakāsī I am not Aḍḍhakāsī; I am called Kāsī. My mother was Aḍḍhakāsī, and thus I am known as Aḍḍhakāsī. She who was my mother has passed away; I have attained final Nibbāna. Having cut off craving for existence, I am no longer subject to birth. I am not Aḍḍhakāsī; I am called Kāsī.
